create_data_channel_manager: create a DataChannelManager with fast and slow xrl DataChannels for batched environment dispatch
create_env_function: create an xrl Context with DualDispatchThreads and a DataChannelManager using create_env
get_input_batches: get input batches from the DataChannelManager with a max timeout in seconds
set_reply_to_channel: set a reply dictionary for a specific channel key via the DataChannelManager
terminate_data_channel_manager: terminate the DataChannelManager to cleanly shut down all data channels
